blocks.text: Who? What? Where? When? How many? With this unit learn to ask questions and answer, and read and fill out a form with personal data. Arab questions have a rule that simplifies everything: they are always at the beginning of the sentence, and the rest does not change. For questions yes/no just put ⁧هَلْ⁩ in the face of a statement.

rows: 6–7 hours · one week (week 21 of the calendar)

blocks.text: Materials This unit, Anki deck A1 (tag A1-06), script for speech synthesis, session with tutor
Targets. At the end of the lesson you know:
1. ask questions yes/no with ⁧هَلْ⁩ and answer with ⁧نَعَمْ⁩ / ⁧لَا⁩ ;
2. use ⁧مَا، مَاذَا، مَنْ، أَيْنَ، كَيْفَ، مَتَى، كَمْ، لِمَاذَا⁩ ;
3. ask and give personal data: first name, surname, age, address, work, telephone;
4. use ⁧كَمْ⁩ by the name to the singular: ⁧كَمْ طَالِبًا؟⁩ ;
5. read and fill out a simple form;
6. understand a slow interview and ask eight questions to the tutor.

blocks.text: ⁧مَا⁩ or ⁧مَاذَا⁩ ? In standard Arabic the choice depends on what follows: ⁧مَا⁩ before a name or pronoun ( ⁧مَا اسْمُكَ؟، مَا هٰذَا؟⁩ ), ⁧مَاذَا⁩ before a verb ( ⁧مَاذَا تَدْرُسُ؟⁩ What are you studying? Verbs arrive in A1-13: for now ⁧مَاذَا تَدْرُسُ؟⁩ and ⁧مَاذَا تَعْمَلُ؟⁩ "What work do you do?" are blocks to learn whole. ⁧أَيّ⁩ is followed by an indeterminate name to the genitive: ⁧أَيُّ مَكْتَبٍ؟⁩ - which office? ⁧أَيُّ سَيَّارَةٍ؟⁩ - Which car? Recognize him; you will actively use it in A2. How to respond to ⁧لِمَاذَا⁩ . The answer begins with ⁧لِأَنَّ⁩ li-anna ... why: the complete construction you will see in A2.
